headline: PM Tarique receives two invitations to visit India, says Jaiswal
summary: Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh Pranay Verma stated that Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has received two invitations to visit India. The details of the invitations were not immediately disclosed.
details: High Commissioner of India to Bangladesh Pranay Verma has revealed that Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has received two separate invitations to visit India. The announcement was made during a press briefing.
Verma did not specify the nature of the invitations or the entities that extended them. Further details regarding the potential visit are expected to be released in due course.

The relationship between Bangladesh and India is multifaceted, encompassing strong economic, cultural, and political ties. High-level visits are common and play a crucial role in strengthening bilateral cooperation.
caption:

Verma did not specify the nature of the invitations or the entities that extended them. Further details regarding the potential visit are expected to be released in due course.

The relationship between Bangladesh and India is multifaceted, encompassing strong economic, cultural, and political ties. High-level visits are common and play a crucial role in strengthening bilateral cooperation.

headline_marked: 7 die as [[1,753 hospitalized with dengue]] in 24 hours
headline: 7 die as 1,753 hospitalized with dengue in 24 hours
summary: The Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room report a surge in admissions across all divisions, with 171 deaths recorded so far this year.
details: According to the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), seven people died from dengue in the last 24 hours.
During the same period, 1,753 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.
The breakdown of admissions shows 394 patients in the Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 175 in Dhaka North City Corporation, and 174 in Dhaka South City Corporation.
Other regions reported significant numbers, including 349 in Khulna, 186 in Barishal, 183 in Mymensingh, 177 in Chattogram, 153 in Rajshahi, 53 in Rangpur, and 9 in Sylhet.
This brings the total number of dengue-related deaths this year to 171, with a total of 56,916 hospitalizations recorded so far.
caption:
7 deaths and 1,753 hospitalizations in just 24 hours. Dengue is taking a deadlier turn.

According to the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), seven people died from dengue in the last 24 hours.

During the same period, 1,753 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.

The breakdown of admissions shows 394 patients in the Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 175 in Dhaka North City Corporation, and 174 in Dhaka South City Corporation.

Other regions reported significant numbers, including 349 in Khulna, 186 in Barishal, 183 in Mymensingh, 177 in Chattogram, 153 in Rajshahi, 53 in Rangpur, and 9 in Sylhet.

This brings the total number of dengue-related deaths this year to 171, with a total of 56,916 hospitalizations recorded so far.

#Bangladesh #Dengue #PublicHealth #DGHS #HealthAlert

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
